mailbox.title: Welcome to TLLPS!
mailbox.message: Heya! Welcome to TLLPS, the private server of the game The Lost Landscapes! Here are some goodies to get you started, but if you want to <color=red>cheat</color>... just press Tab and start writing! Good luck, eh!

mailbox.title: Regarding the unofficial links
mailbox.message:
If you have downloaded TLLPS anywhere that isn't the official Hacked Landscapes discord, do NOT share the link you used but the official discord one (where you should join to get the original version AND to actually support us, unlike those who spread the fake download): https://discord.gg/ZxTPRE2GXC

There is a list of people who have shared TLLPS without crediting the owner. If it's someone on YouTube, unsubscribe to them.

Elicrabs (YouTube)
minecrafter_random (Reddit)
Jbneves (YouTube)

mailbox.title: DO NOT use this website!
mailbox.message:
We have found a fake TLLPS website, showcasing it as TLL Reborn. It goes against the rules. 

It does credit the discord server, BUT, in the description, they said the owners are Elicrabs and Minecraft dude.

What about these two? These two dudes specifically, they are the ones who stole TLLPS first, and the ones who did not take down their posts (or refused to acknowledge their mistakes).

The website is "websim.com/@mrparappafan/tll-reborn", DO NOT use it and make sure to warn others that this is NOT the official way to download the private server. If you came from that site, please join the discord server Hacked Landscapes and make sure to have the real version.
